text: After watching a frightened man drive a knife into his own eye, the freelance cameraman Masuoka goes looking for the fear he saw, [descending into tunnels beneath Tokyo|images|wild and lonely places]. Among ruins far underground he finds a naked young woman chained to a wall and [brings her back to his apartment|trigger|bringing something home]. She does not eat or speak, and watching her through his cameras he learns that she [lives on blood|wants|feeding on the living], which he begins to supply.
